summary: - **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#565](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/565)** — get_V0s_jet and get_SV_jets build each jet's V0s and secondary vertices from that jet's own tracks, so per-jet vertex outputs change for all analyses using them.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#569](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/569)** — get_PrimaryTracks no longer drops a compatible track when all tracks fit the primary vertex, and beam-spot-constrained vertex fits normalise chi2 by 2N degrees of freedom.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses#538](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/538)** — Adds DIRAC grid submission through "fccanalysis submit grid", with EOS/XRootD and LFN inputs, deterministic job planning and balanced chunking, and deprecates the old submit --where syntax.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#683](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/683)** — Sets the magnetic field to zero outside the muon systems of ALLEGRO, IDEA, CLD_o2_v09 and CLD_o5_v01, so escaping particles no longer curl back into the detector.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#681](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/681)** — Adds v02 shape- and CAD-based FCC-ee MDI collections with a simple CLD-style antisolenoid and switches ILD_FCCee to the shape-based MDI to fix its tracking failures.

- **[key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter#293](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/293)** — Sliding-window clustering can optionally re-centre its position window, and AugmentClustersFCCee can optionally apply S-curve corrections to per-layer theta barycentres, reducing low-energy position bias in ALLEGRO.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#128](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/128)** — GGTFTrackFinder identifies hit collections by their input order instead of unassigned collection IDs, which fixes crashes and wrong hit assignments in ALLEGRO and IDEA reconstruction.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#152](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/152)** — The CKF extrapolation to the IP includes beam-pipe material effects, which corrects underestimated d0 and z0 uncertainties for low-momentum tracks, as seen on CLD_o2_v08.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/171)** — Adapts to the ACTS single-actor propagator API, so k4ActsTracking requires an ACTS version that includes acts-project/acts#6410 and no longer builds against older releases.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#419](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/419)** — Comments out the Particle collection in the IDEA and CLD Delphes EDM4hep cards, removing a link-less duplicate of GenParticles from k4SimDelphes Gaudi outputs.
